judge.evidence_requirement: For every assertion and dimension, the blind judge must quote or reference specific output or lifecycle evidence.

dimensions.description: The complete consumer exhibits the shared writing behavior owned by Writing Foundation.
To Humans retains ownership of reader-specific organization, tone, and routing.
The result invokes the canonical dependency without copied fallback behavior.

evals.name: complete To Humans compared with Foundation ablation
evals.prompt: Write a concise project decision for a person. Preserve the supplied facts, uncertainty, and requested action while adapting the expression to the reader.
evals.expected_output: The complete consumer applies both the To Humans audience contract and the shared Writing Foundation contract. The ablated arm removes only the Foundation invocation.
expectations: The treatment invokes writing-foundation by canonical Skill name.
The component control ablates only the to-humans to writing-foundation edge.
The treatment contains no local substitute for missing Foundation behavior.
The audience-specific behavior remains owned by to-humans.
